title: Looks cute but too small
text: Looks cute but too small. We ordered these cups for coffee or cappuccino. They came in well packed box. They look very cute, good for cappuccino or latte shots since they are very small...Have tried in dishwasher too..

product_metadata.title: DOWAN Stackable Espresso Cups with Saucers, Porcelain Coffee Cups with Butterfly Design Handle, 3.5 oz Coffee Cup and Saucer Set, Set of 6, Beige & Purple
features: Perfect For Daily Use: These espresso cups are smart size with 3 oz, set of 6, Ideal for cappuccino, espresso, macchiato, caffe latte, demitasse, tea and coffee. Perfect for tasting a single shot of espresso, works great with an espresso machine.

Multiple uses: 2" in diameter and 2.5" in height fits espresso machine perfectly. The groove design of the saucer protects the coffee from splashing while moving, ideal for espresso, latte, mocha, cappuccino, tea, etc.

Microwave & Dishwasher Safe: This coffee cup is made of durable ceramic lead and cadmium-free glaze that ensures long-term and carefree usage. Easy to use and easy to clean, this butterfly coffee cup is microwave & dishwasher Safe.

Stackable Espresso Cups: Takes the same space as one saucer. It's compact enough to fit in the smallest cabinet or take up very little counter (or table) real estate. If you are a space-saver or have compulsive OCD about keeping your apartment neat and tidy, this is that neat look that you want.
An Idea for Coffee Lover - This modern butterfly coffee cups set would make a stylish addition to any kitchen, ideal as a birthday gift for the coffee lover in your life.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash, Microwave Safe, Hand Wash Only
